risks.reasoning: For the three months ended March 31, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash used in operating activities of RMB1,233,256 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB13,962,570 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB411,085 thousand, giving a cash runway of approximately 33.97 months, above the 12-month trigger.

The accountants' report shows profit for the year/period of RMB5,471,078 thousand, RMB7,109,363 thousand, RMB12,441,251 thousand, RMB3,427,625 thousand and RMB2,933,672 thousand for 2019, 2020, 2021, Q1 2021 and Q1 2022 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods.

Revenue decreased from RMB18,133,529 thousand in the three months ended March 31, 2021 to RMB16,782,286 thousand in the same period of 2022, a decline of approximately 7.45%. The decline is below zero but above the -20% high threshold, so the frozen medium revenue-growth threshold is triggered.

The formal customer disclosure states that none of the Group's customers accounted for 5% or more of total revenue in 2019, 2020, 2021 or Q1 2022 and that the Group did not rely on any single customer. This strict bound is far below the frozen concentration thresholds.

For the three months ended March 31, 2022, purchases from the largest supplier accounted for 30.2% and purchases from the top five suppliers accounted for 56.7% of total purchases. The largest-supplier share exceeds the 30% medium threshold, while the top-five share remains below the 60% medium threshold; neither reaches the high thresholds.

The Company has been listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange since 2009 and its controlling shareholder, CTG, acquired control through a state-owned share transfer. No external pre-IPO investor holding redemption, repurchase, put or other restorable special rights was disclosed in the corporate history.

The formal Legal and Arbitration Proceedings section states there were no litigation, arbitration or administrative proceedings pending or threatened with a material adverse effect as of the Latest Practicable Date. However, the disclosed idle-land compliance matter remained subject to a construction commencement deadline extended to November 2022, with a potential idle-land fee of RMB174.1 million or, in the event of forfeiture, loss of land premium of RMB870.3 million. Because the deadline and regulatory consequence were not finally resolved at the date of the prospectus, the risk is left as needs_review rather than rejected.

The Group is an established global travel retail operator with substantial revenue from continuing operations throughout the Track Record Period. Its core duty-free retail business is fully commercialized and revenue-generating; it is not a precommercial product-development issuer.
